title: Tiny, cute pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body, tilted slightly -->
  <!-- wooden tip triangle -->
  <polygon points='30,72 22,58 40,62' fill='#e8b77a'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='30,72 26.5,66 33.5,66' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- yellow barrel -->
  <polygon points='40,62 22,58 30,40 48,44' fill='#f7d64a'/>
  <polygon points='30,40 48,44 56,26 38,22' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- barrel ridge lines -->
  <line x1='34' y1='51' x2='52' y2='55' stroke='#e0b830' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ferrule metal band -->
  <polygon points='38,22 56,26 60,16 42,12' fill='#cfd6e0'/>
  <polygon points='42,12 60,16 61,13 43,9' fill='#eef2f8'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <polygon points='43,9 61,13 64,4 46,0.5' fill='#f28ba8'/>
  <polygon points='46,0.5 64,4 65,2 47,-1' fill='#ffb3c8'/>
  <!-- tiny face on barrel: cute eyes and smile -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='2.4' fill='#3d3d5c'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='50.5' r='2.4' fill='#3d3d5c'/>
  <path d='M38,55 Q42,58.5 46,56.5' stroke='#3d3d5c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#ff9db8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#ff9db8' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
